An open-ended feedback study: what attendees say worked and what to change, analysed as text. surveyframe declares the analysis in advance (Word frequencies, Phrase frequencies, Words in context, Word co-occurrence, Word co-occurrence network, Sentiment analysis, Document-feature matrix, Topic model (LDA), Structural topic model) and reports it in APA 7.

## In SurveyStudio

In RStudio, open the Addins menu, choose **surveyframe: Try a demo** and pick `open_text`. The study opens on the Design screen. Plan shows each research question with its method and decision rule, Analyse runs them as declared, and Report writes the APA 7 report.

![The Design screen with the open_text study.](../../templates/open_text/design.png){width=100%}

## In R

```r
d <- sframe_demo("open_text")
results <- run_analysis_plan(d$responses, d$instrument)
render_report(d$instrument, d$responses)
```

## What the report gives

| Research question | Method | What the report gives |
|---|---|---|
| Which words come up most often? | Word frequencies | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| And which pairs of words? | Phrase frequencies | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| How is a key word actually used? | Words in context | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| Which words appear together? | Word co-occurrence | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| Do in-person and online attendees say different things? | Word frequencies | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| Which words cluster together? | Word co-occurrence network | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| Is the tone positive or negative? | Sentiment analysis | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| What does a document-feature matrix show? | Document-feature matrix | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| What topics are people writing about? | Topic model (LDA) | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| The same question with a structural topic model. | Structural topic model | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |

The demo's data is simulated, so the site shows no numbers. Run it in SurveyStudio or R to see the results, each marked as demonstration data.
